paragraphs.text: The Sea of Whales is a sea in the Domains of Dominaria . It lies east of Hammerheim , south of Cape Tempest (both North Aerona ) and west of the Orvada Empire . It derives its name from the huge schools of whales that pass by every winter. To the north lies the Howling Sea .
